description: Compare two to six GL.iNet Comet KVM over IP models side by side: one row per fact (computers controlled, video, Ethernet, PoE, Wi-Fi, cellular, HDMI out, screen, power, size, weight) with one value per model in the order given, plus each model's live price in UAH, stock and page URL. Use it when the user weighs KVM models against each other; find candidates first with akulacyber_search_products (category kvm), and use akulacyber_get_product for one product or any accessory. An accessory or unknown product returns an error naming it and listing the KVM slugs. A null value means the model lacks the feature.

lang.description: Language of the texts and page URLs in the answer: uk (Ukrainian, the default), ru (Russian) or en (English). Use the language the user writes in.

products.description: Two to six KVMs, each a slug or model code as in search results, e.g. ["gl-rm1", "GL-RM1PE"].

name: akulacyber_compare_kvms
title: Compare AkulaCyber KVM models
